subject: Control-domain fencing: modular enclave proofset + CIDR pack for SOC 2 / SIG
messages:
From: Tim Arnold <tim.arnold@greenline.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Audits Team <audits@veridian.com>, Greenline InfoSec <security@greenline.com>
Date: 2027-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: mapping & proofset for Dedicated/Private — SOC 2 / SIG

Hi Dev,

Thanks for the call earlier. Our InfoSec team needs a compact deliverable we can attach to our SOC 2 file for the upcoming audit:

- A CIDR-level mapping of the Dedicated/Private deployment variants that shows which ranges are customer-facing, control-plane only, and interconnects to customer VPCs.
- A short narrative (1–2 pages) describing the control-domain fencing model (controlplane isolation, egress restrictions, KMS boundaries) that we can include in the SIG/CAIQ evidence set.
- Any diagrams (PDF) that show enclave boundaries and peering constructs.

Deadline: our SOC 2 window opens 2027-07-01; having the pack by 2027-06-23 would give us time to review.

Can you confirm what you can provide and whether you need any additional info from our side?

Thanks,
Tim
Tim Arnold
Head of Cloud Risk, Greenline Health Systems
security@greenline.com

(Attachment: none)

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Request: mapping & proofset for Dedicated/Private — SOC 2 / SIG

Team — forwarding Greenline's ask. TL;DR: they want a compact ‘proofset’ (CIDR mapping + 1–2 page control narrative + diagrams) for SOC 2 / SIG. Target delivery 2027-06-23.

Proposed split of work:
- Kimberly: produce the narrative + enclave diagram (technical details + KMS boundary language). Attach: enclave-diagram-v2.pdf (stub).
- Ben: produce the CIDR mapping CSV and short mapping table; include which ranges are controlplane-only and which permit customer VPC peering. Attach: cidr-mapping-20270618.csv (stub).
- Laura: review the SIG/CAIQ phrasing and produce the final sig-responses-draft.docx (stub) and coordinate with Greenline for scheduling a walkthrough.

Notes / quick technical bullets to include in the narrative:
- Controlplane runs in a logically separate VPC range (10.100.0.0/16) and is not routable from customer VPCs except via authenticated peering connections that terminate at per-tenant NAT gateways.
- In Dedicated, tenant-facing inference nodes live in 10.200.0.0/16 subblocks (one /20 per tenant by default); controlplane traffic uses a set of management subnets (10.100.0.0/18).
- Private (VPC) deployments: customer VPC CIDRs are documented in the mapping; Redwood-maintained controlplane endpoints are reach-only via mTLS and restricted egress.
- KMS: customer keys never leave the customer KMS in Private mode; for Dedicated we run an HSM-backed KMS tenant key envelope with strict access logs.

I attached quick stubs for the attachments above so we can iterate.

Action: Kimberly + Ben + Laura please ack and send first drafts by EOD 2027-06-20 so I can bundle and send to Greenline on 06-21 for their internal review.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com
(Attachments: cidr-mapping-20270618.csv [stub], enclave-diagram-v2.pdf [stub], sig-responses-draft.docx [stub])

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-18T12:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Request: mapping & proofset for Dedicated/Private — SOC 2 / SIG

Dev / team — ACK and first draft attached. Quick technical clarifications included inline here and in the draft narrative:

1) CIDR conventions (example rows to include in CSV):
- 10.100.0.0/16, controlplane, management-only, no-customer-ingress
- 10.200.0.0/20, tenant-A, inference-subnet, peering-allowed (mTLS + NAT egress)
- 10.200.16.0/20, tenant-B, inference-subnet, peering-allowed
- 10.250.0.0/24, shared-services, logging/metrics aggregator, egress-whitelisted

2) Control-plane access model:
- Control-plane endpoints require mutual TLS and token-bound session keys. We log every control-plane operation in an append-only audit stream forwarded to the customer-specific audit bucket (for Dedicated) or to Redwood-managed audit retention (hosted).

3) KMS notes to include in SIG entry:
- Dedicated: HSM-backed KMS within Redwood tenant boundary; per-tenant key-wrapping and strict separation of key-access roles.
- Private: customer-provided KMS; Redwood services obtain wrapped keys via envelope decryption only after successful attestation.

Attachments included: enclave-diagram-v2.pdf (diagram showing border subnets, peering terminators, and NAT egress points), sig-responses-draft.docx (draft narrative).

I kept the narrative to ~900 words and added a short control-plane glossary for auditors. Ben — please replace the CIDR sample rows with the full CSV you generate.

Kimberly Park
Security Architect, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
(Attachment: enclave-diagram-v2.pdf [attached], sig-responses-draft.docx [attached])

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Tim Arnold <tim.arnold@greenline.com>
Cc: Greenline InfoSec <security@greenline.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-18T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: mapping & proofset for Dedicated/Private — SOC 2 / SIG

Tim — thanks for the clear ask. Please find the initial pack attached:
- cidr-mapping-20270618.csv (authoritative CIDR mapping with tags: purpose/controlplane/peering)
- enclave-diagram-v2.pdf (annotated boundary diagram; shows management subnets, tenant subnets, NAT egress points)
- sig-responses-draft.docx (1.2 page narrative tailored for SIG/CAIQ)

High-level summary for your auditors:
- Control-plane and tenant inference planes are separated by distinct CIDR ranges and routing controls. Control-plane endpoints are only reachable via authenticated peering or internal management networks; customer-initiated traffic terminates at tenant NATs that enforce egress policies.
- Key management: Dedicated deployments use Redwood HSM-backed KMS with per-tenant key wrapping. Private deployments are configured to use customer-managed KMS; Redwood does not persist plaintext keys.
- Evidence included: audit log sample (timestamped control-plane operation IDs are referenced in the narrative), diagram, and CIDR mapping. Full audit logs are available under NDA or via an evidence-sharing bucket if required.

Next steps:
1) If this looks good, can we schedule a 45-minute walkthrough the week of 2027-06-28? Laura will coordinate availability.
2) If auditors need deeper artifacts (pcap traces, attestation logs), flag that and we will route a controlled evidence request.

Thanks — attaching stubs now; happy to expand any section.

Best,
Dev Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.com

(Attachments: cidr-mapping-20270618.csv [attached], enclave-diagram-v2.pdf [attached], sig-responses-draft.docx [attached])
